Variants.Content: Bronzegate City is located in the northern part of the Stormlands, close to the land route leading to the Crown Land and King's Landing. It is the ancestral castle of the Bukele family. It belongs to the feudal system of Storm's End, and its gates and road controls make it an important barrier when entering the Stormlands from the north.
